text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! I won~! Turns out runnin' like my 
life depended on it did the trick, yep!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, just when I thought it was over, my 
knees are shaking so bad it's exhausting~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hey there! Winning really does feel so 
cozy and good!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin was in such high spirits that 
her hometown dialect slipped out 
naturally.
choice_data_list: That was an incredible run, wasn't it!

Keep that spirit up and let's do our best 
next time too!

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I was able to run in a way that 
satisfied even myself! I really feel like 
I've grown a ton~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's give it our all next time 
too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Yeah, yer right! Ain't no way I'm 
lettin' 'em push me around!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right, I gotta work super hard in 
training so I can win the next race too!
